operation.name: ED50 to WGS 84 (18)
operation.why: Best stated accuracy (1 m) for the UK North Sea; area 'Europe - common offshore' contains all points (Norway-specific 1613/1612 don't cover the UK sector). Chosen explicitly, not PROJ's default.

assumptions: Read as ED50 (EPSG:4230) decimal degrees, latitude first, west negative; all points in the UK sector offshore.
notes: Datum shifts in the expected 110-125 m range; round trip checked internally.
